headline: Clinton order sets up a process for handling complaints of wrongdoing made against federal Inspectors General.
what_it_does: This executive order deals with administrative allegations, meaning complaints of misconduct that are not criminal charges, made against federal Inspectors General. Inspectors General are the officials who investigate waste, fraud, and abuse inside federal agencies. The order creates a way to receive, review, and look into these complaints. No summary was provided, so the exact steps and who carries them out are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal Inspectors General and possibly their senior staff
who_it_affects.how: Complaints of misconduct made against them would be handled through the process this order sets up.

who_it_affects.group: Federal employees and members of the public who report misconduct by an Inspector General
who_it_affects.how: The order sets out a process for how their complaints are received and reviewed.
